{{Quote|We've ''found'' the trooper, monitor control. Playback of his ''recording unit'' indicates he stopped a lone ''female'' coming from the docking area for ''routine questioning''.|The officer reports on a condition red|<ref name="APL" />}}
A member of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] force on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], an '''Imperial officer''' served under [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Corwyth]]'s rule. During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Officer/Legends|officer]] investigated a [[condition red]] at [[Post 994-203]]. A [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Metalorn)|lone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] had been ambushed by [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], and his traceable [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] had been abducted. The officer's investigation revealed the method in which Organa incapacitated the trooper, and the officer reported his findings back to Corwyth.

==Biography==
{{Quote|He was about to check an ''irregularity'' on her papers... When she ''attacked''!|The officer reports on the fate of a stormtrooper|<ref name="APL" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]], and served under the command of [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Corwyth]].<ref name="APL" />

[[File:Knockout_trooper_metalorn.png|thumb|left|200px|Princess Organa's victim, as found by the officer.]]
During the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]],<ref name="NEC">[[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]] takes place after the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], but before the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]], which ''The New Essential Chronology'' dates to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] infiltrated the Imperial [[Mining/Legends|mining]] facilities on Metalorn on a mission to find her old [[Arn Horada|mentor]]. Disguised as a citizen, she was approached by a [[Unidentified stormtrooper (Metalorn)|lone]] [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] at [[Post 994-203]], whom she attacked and disarmed. Afterwards, Organa took the [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]], unaware of the elaborate tracking system installed on it. With the blaster being removed form the possession of its owner, a [[condition red]] alerted Corwyth's command center.<ref name="APL" />

As such, the Imperial officer was sent to investigate the stormtrooper's last known location. Along with a squad of other stormtroopers, the officer found the incapacitated trooper. Using a playback feature in the [[Trooper/Legends|trooper's]] [[Helmet/Legends|helmet's]] [[Recording rod|recording unit]], the officer learned of Organa and trooper's encounter. Further investigation revealed that Organa had used an adhesive spray from a first aid kit to clog the ventilation system of the trooper's helmet. The officer reported his findings back to Corwyth, who dispatched further squads to apprehend the Princess.<ref name="APL" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|The assailant was ''clever''... Used ''adhesive spray'' from a first aid pack to clog the ''ventilation system'' of our man's armor.|The officer admits that Princess Organa's ambush was cleverly executed|<ref name="APL" />}}
The officer was a [[Color/Legends|light]]-skinned human male. After learning about how Organa incapacitated the Post 994-203 trooper, the officer admitted that he thought the Princess' maneuver was clever.<ref name="APL" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Imperial officer was created for the [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars (1977) 30|''Star Wars'' (1977) 30]], an issue of the [[Marvel Comics]] [[Star Wars (1977)|''Star Wars'']] series. Released on [[December 30]], [[1979]], ''A Princess Alone'' was written by [[Archie Goodwin]] and illustrated by [[Carmine Infantino]] and [[Gene Day]].<ref name="APL" />
